invariants.statement: An order is not fulfilled before payment is verified server-side.
invariants.verification: Assert seeded unpaid order cannot be fulfilled through any user-facing endpoint.
In provider sandbox, submit an invalid-signature fixture and assert order state is unchanged.
Replay the same disposable provider event and assert no duplicate ledger/fulfilment side effects.

invariants.statement: Order amount, currency, merchant, and order reference are verified against server-side records.
invariants.verification: Use seeded mismatched fixtures; assert no paid/fulfilled transition.

invariants.statement: One test user cannot read or alter another test user's order.
invariants.verification: Use two separate test identities and seeded objects; assert per-operation authorization.

invariants.statement: Cancelled or expired orders do not transition to paid through unsupported paths.
invariants.verification: Use disposable orders and documented reconciliation path only.
Assert duplicate confirmations do not generate duplicate entitlements/ledger effects.

invariants.statement: Sensitive business operations have server-enforced eligibility/rate constraints.
invariants.verification: Run only a bounded, approved test case against a test-only fixture.
